vulnerability_analysis: The TokenTool contract has a multipleBotlistAddress() function that is only callable by the owner. This function can arbitrarily blacklist any address by setting _isBlacklisted[address] = true. When an address is blacklisted, they cannot send or receive tokens due to the check in _transfer(). This demonstrates owner privilege abuse where the owner can unilaterally block any address from transacting.
attack_strategy: 1. Use storage slot manipulation to become the owner of the deployed contract. 2. Call multipleBotlistAddress() with the victim's address to blacklist them. 3. Verify the victim is now blacklisted.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Determine the storage slot for _owner (should be slot 0). 2. Use vm.store() to set _owner to our attacker address. 3. Create an array containing the victim address. 4. Call multipleBotlistAddress() with the array and true. 5. Check that _isBlacklisted[victim] returns true.
